meta.project: Aerojet Academy Portal - Pathways, Wallet & Pooling

product_overview: Student portal that enforces pathway-based access, a centralized wallet, exam pooling and booking, plus staff administration. The system locks a student's chosen study pathway at first-login and routes booking/payment flows through a single wallet to enforce business rules (pooling, milestones, tuition).
core_goals: Enforce Pathway selection and locking on first login so each student sees only pathway-appropriate UI and services.
Implement a Universal Wallet: top-up, reserve, capture, release, and full audit trail for every payment flow.
Provide exam pooling (reserve → capture) and individual booking (capture) flows that are atomic and race-condition resistant.
Ensure role-based access for Students, Staff/Admin, Instructors and Applicants and provide admin controls (approvals, overrides, audit).
Expose clear, pathway-aware course catalog and booking UX so Full-Time, Modular and Exam-Only users see only what is allowed.

features.name: User Authentication (Login & Registration)
features.description: Sign-up, sign-in and session creation. Supports registration, forced password change on first login and session cookie issuance.
user_flows: Navigate to /register -> Fill registration form -> Submit registration form -> See confirmation message instructing to upload payment proof -> Receive email with next steps
Navigate to /login -> Fill login/registration forms -> Submit credentials -> Receive session cookie -> Redirect to first-login pathway wizard or /student
Navigate to /login -> Fill login form with incorrect password -> Submit credentials -> See error message 'Invalid credentials' -> Stay on /login

features.name: Pathway Selection Wizard (First-login)
features.description: Immediate first-login wizard that requires the student to choose exactly one pathway (FULL_TIME, EXAM_ONLY, MODULAR, MILITARY). Choice is locked and visible in their profile; only admins can override with audit trail.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Submit credentials -> See Pathway Selection wizard (must choose) -> Select 'EXAM_ONLY' -> Click Confirm selection -> See confirmation modal 'This cannot be changed' -> Receive success notification -> Redirect to /student dashboard

Navigate to /login -> Submit credentials -> See Pathway Selection wizard -> Attempt to navigate to /courses without selecting pathway -> System blocks navigation -> Show message 'Please choose your study pathway first' (403 PATHWAY_REQUIRED)
Navigate to /student -> Attempt to change pathway after locked -> Click 'Change' -> UI prevents change and shows admin override instructions -> No pathway change permitted

features.name: Course Catalog Filtering (Pathway-aware UI)
features.description: Filter course catalog and available purchase options based on the student's locked pathway (hide/show modules, tuition, exam-only variations).
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Login as Modular student -> Navigate to /courses -> See full list of individual EASA Modules -> Click module to view tuition + exam options

Navigate to /login -> Login as Full-Time student -> Navigate to /courses -> See only high-level programme info and Skilled Short Courses (individual EASA modules hidden) -> Attempt to select module purchase -> System shows 'Not available for your pathway' (403 PATHWAY_NOT_ELIGIBLE)

Navigate to /login -> Login as Exam-Only student -> Navigate to /courses -> See 'Exam-Only' versions of Modules 1-17 (exam booking only) -> Attempt to access study materials -> System returns 'Access denied' (no tuition access)

features.name: Universal Wallet - Top-up, Reserve, Capture, Release
features.description: Single wallet per student that stores available and reserved balances. All payments (top-ups, pool reserves, captures on confirmation, tuition, milestone payments and refunds) go through the wallet with full transaction audit.
user_flows: Navigate to /student -> Click Wallet -> Click 'Top Up Wallet' -> Enter amount and upload proof -> Submit top-up request -> See 'Pending' top-up notification
Staff navigates to /staff -> View pending top-up -> Click 'Approve' -> System posts TOP_UP transaction -> Student wallet available_balance increases -> Student receives 'WALLET_CREDITED' email

Navigate to /student -> Attempt to reserve funds for pool with available_balance lower than required -> Click Join Pool -> System checks wallet.available_balance -> Show error 'Insufficient wallet balance' with top-up CTA

features.name: Exam Pool Join (Reserve → Capture)
features.description: Exam-only pooling flow where joining a pool RESERVES funds (e.g., €300) and the system auto-confirms a pool and CAPTURES funds when the pool reaches the minimum (25). Only EXAM_ONLY students may use pooling endpoints.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Login as EXAM_ONLY student -> Navigate to /courses (or My Pools) -> Open Pool A details -> Click 'Join Pool' -> Confirm module selection -> System validates pathway and wallet -> System creates RESERVE transaction and reduces available balance -> Membership created with status RESERVED -> See 'Reserved' confirmation

Multiple students concurrently: Several students join Pool A -> When the 25th reservation succeeds the system runs atomic transaction to CAPTURE reserved funds for all members -> Pool status becomes CONFIRMED -> Users receive 'POOL CONFIRMED' notification and membership status CONFIRMED

Navigate to /login -> Login as STUDENT with pathway FULL_TIME -> Attempt to call pool join endpoint -> System checks pathway -> Return HTTP 403 PATHWAY_NOT_ELIGIBLE -> Show error message 'Pooling is only available to EXAM_ONLY students'

features.name: Individual Exam Booking (Capture)
features.description: Individual exam seat booking that immediately CAPTURES funds (e.g., €520) from the wallet and creates a confirmed exam booking. Available to EXAM_ONLY students for individual seats (also used by other pathways when allowed).
user_flows: Navigate to /courses -> Select module 'M1' -> Choose 'Individual Exam Seat' -> Click 'Book' -> System validates pathway and wallet.available_balance >= €520 -> System creates booking and CAPTURE wallet transaction -> Booking status becomes CONFIRMED -> Send 'EXAM_BOOKING_CONFIRMED' email
Navigate to /courses -> Select module -> Click 'Book' with available_balance < €520 -> System validates and shows 'Insufficient wallet balance' with top-up link -> Booking not created
Navigate to /courses -> Select individual exam as FULL_TIME student where allowed -> Click 'Book' -> System checks pathway rules -> If endpoint not permitted for pathway, return 403 and show message

features.name: Modular Package Purchase (Capture & Grant Access)
features.description: MODULAR pathway users purchase pre-packaged modular bundles or single modules. Purchase captures full price from wallet, activates modular enrollment, grants access to learning materials and sets validity windows.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Login as MODULAR student -> Navigate to /courses -> Select 'Foundation 4-Pack' -> Click 'Purchase' -> System validates pathway and wallet.available_balance >= price -> System creates enrollment and CAPTURE transaction -> Enrollment status CONFIRMED and materials access granted -> Send 'MODULAR_PACKAGE_PURCHASED' email

Navigate to /login -> Login as EXAM_ONLY student -> Attempt to purchase modular package -> Click 'Purchase' -> System validates pathway -> Return 403 PATHWAY_NOT_ELIGIBLE -> Show message 'Modular packages require MODULAR pathway'
Navigate to /login -> Login as MODULAR student -> Attempt purchase with insufficient wallet balance -> Submit purchase -> System rejects with 'Insufficient wallet balance' and top-up instructions

features.name: Full-Time Enrollment & Milestone Payments (Generate → Pay → Activate)
features.description: Full-time enrolment flow generates payment milestones (Year 1: 40/30/30; Years 2+: 50/50). Seat confirmation milestone must be paid to activate the enrollment. Payments are captured from wallet and milestones marked PAID on success.
user_flows: Staff or student initiates enrollment via admin or student UI -> System creates FullTimeEnrollment record with status PENDING_CONFIRMATION and generates milestones -> Student views milestones in /student dashboard -> Student clicks 'Pay Seat Confirmation' -> System validates wallet.available_balance >= seat_amount -> System CAPTURES funds and marks milestone PAID -> Enrollment transitions to ACTIVE -> Send 'ENROLLMENT_ACTIVATED' email
Student attempts to pay a milestone with wallet.available_balance < amount_due -> Click 'Pay' -> System shows 'Insufficient wallet balance' with top-up URL -> Milestone remains DUE
Attempt to create enrollment for a student without pathway FULL_TIME -> System requires pathway FULL_TIME and returns 403 PATHWAY_NOT_ELIGIBLE

features.name: Tuition Session Booking & Minimum Class Size
features.description: Book tuition/revision sessions (100% upfront). System captures funds immediately and tracks enrollment counts; runs a scheduled check (T-7) to cancel runs that don't meet min_class_size and issues credits to wallets.
user_flows: Navigate to /student -> Browse tuition runs -> Select 'M1 Revision' run -> Click 'Book' -> System validates pathway (EXAM_ONLY or MODULAR or configured FULL_TIME) and wallet -> System CAPTURES funds and creates tuition booking -> tuition_run.current_enrollments increments -> Booking status CONFIRMED -> Send 'TUITION_BOOKING_CONFIRMED' email

Cron job runs 7 days before run -> Identify runs with current_enrollments < min_class_size -> Cancel run -> For each confirmed booking create CREDIT transaction to the student's wallet and set booking CANCELLED -> Send 'TUITION_CANCELLED_REFUNDED' emails
Student attempts to book a tuition run that is FULL or CLOSED -> Click 'Book' -> System shows 'Tuition session is full' or 'Not open' -> Booking not created

features.name: Staff / Admin Management (Approvals, Overrides & Audit)
features.description: Staff portal where admins review top-up proofs, approve payments, manage exam events/pools, and perform rare pathway overrides with audit logging and migration modes (BLOCK_IF_BOOKINGS, MIGRATE_CANCEL_AND_CREDIT).
user_flows: Navigate to /staff -> Staff logs in -> See administrative overview with pending payments and events -> Click pending top-up -> Verify bank transfer and payment proof -> Click 'Post Top-up' -> System creates TOP_UP wallet transaction, updates wallet, sends 'WALLET_CREDITED' email

Navigate to /staff -> View student record -> Click 'Change Pathway' -> Enter new_pathway and mode=MIGRATE_CANCEL_AND_CREDIT -> Click Submit -> System checks active bookings -> Cancel bookings, credit wallets as required, update student.study_pathway fields and create audit log entry -> Send 'PATHWAY_CHANGED' email to student

Navigate to /staff -> Attempt to override pathway with mode BLOCK_IF_BOOKINGS when student has active bookings -> Click Submit -> System returns error 'Student has active bookings. Use migration mode.' -> Admin sees failure and required steps
